messages:
maria: Quick ask — can someone run a smoke + latency sweep for zephyrus-4b-lite in eu-west1? Need numbers for product demo Monday. Target seq=128, batch=1/4/8. Include int8 & fp16. Thanks!

devon: I can take it. I'll run on a single A100 first and post results. Any perf config to try besides default?

maria: thx @devon. Try `--prefetch 4 --max-batch-ms 5` and also a conservative `--batch-ms 50` run. Also enable KV cache warmup for 16 tokens.

devon: got it. kicking off runs now. tag me if you want a canary on dedicated later.

bench-bot: Job queued: `bench/run -m zephyrus-4b-lite -seq 128 -batch 1,4,8 -dtype [fp16,int8] -region eu-west1 -gpu a100`. Job id: 45219

lee: FYI int8 quant profile is experimental for this model; expect slightly higher latency variance. Watch OOMs.

devon: First pass (A100, fp16): batch=1 p50 18ms p95 34ms, batch=4 p50 42ms p95 90ms, batch=8 p50 85ms p95 210ms. No OOMs. Throughput ~37 tok/s for batch=8.

devon: Int8 (A100, quantized w/ per-channel): batch=1 p50 20ms p95 40ms, batch=4 p50 48ms p95 130ms, batch=8 p50 110ms p95 320ms. Slight drop in tail and two p95 spikes around 03:14 UTC (noisy host).

nora: Can you attach the raw perf CSV and the command lines? I'll add to the onboarding doc.

devon: Uploaded CSV and run commands to internal path: https://internal.redwood/benchmarks/45219 and also small summary gist: https://gist.internal/zephyrus-45219

devon: Quick profiling snapshot with `nsys` shows kernel stall around self-attn for seq=128 at batch 8 — likely memory thrash due to KV allocation. Attaching top flame snippet.

oliver: Suggest trying `--kv-cache-alloc static` + `--tiling 32` to reduce allocator churn. Also try `--disable-eager-emb` to measure impact.

devon: Re-ran batch=8 fp16 with `--kv-cache-alloc static --tiling 32` => p50 78ms p95 165ms. Tail improved, p95 down from 210->165ms. Throughput slightly better.

maria: Amazing. Can we get a small canary on a Dedicated instance (2xA100) to validate scaling? I'll schedule with infra.

sre-bot: Canary scheduled on dedicated-pool-2xA100 for 2026-03-19T09:30Z. If it fails, fallback to hosted.

lee: Also add a regression check vs our baseline model (heron-8b) for quality/loss; embeddings drift minimal?

devon: Ran quick eval: perplexity diff <0.5% vs baseline on eval set. No obvious quality regressions.

nora: I'll draft the onboarding PR with results + suggest config: default fp16, enable `--kv-cache-alloc static` for batch>=8, and int8 only for non-tail-sensitive workloads. Ping for review.

maria: Great. @nora thanks — please include the NVProf traces. Also mark whether to limit int8 in Dedicated by default.

nora: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/onboard/zephyrus4b-lite/PR-238 — includes CSVs, nsys traces, and suggested runtime flags.

oliver: Quick code-review note — in runtime defaults, consider adding `kv_cache_alloc: static` as optional knob when `max_batch_ms>20`.

devon: small follow-up: noticed one p95 outlier in int8 that correlates to host CPU load. Recommend running with `--cpu-isolate` for clean tails.

maria: OK next steps: merge PR after 2 approvals, schedule canary on Dedicated, add model to catalog with recommended flags. :thumbsup: 

bench-bot: Job 45219 completed and archived. Results pushed to internal db.

sre-bot: Canary completed: scaling to 2xA100 observed ~1.9x throughput, tails improved. No incident. Link: https://internal.redwood/canary/45219

lee: I'll add a short note to runbook about int8 tail variance for small sequence lengths.

nora: @maria merging now. Thanks everyone.
